title: History of the Princess of Daryabar
summary: The Princess of Daryabar recounted her extraordinary life before the court of Harran:
keywords: history of the princess of daryabar
full_text:
The Princess of Daryabar recounted her extraordinary life before the court of Harran:

'I was the daughter of the King of the Isle of Daryabar. A military rebellion overthrew my father’s throne, and I escaped aboard a merchant vessel. A violent storm wrecked the ship, and I was washed ashore on a desolate rocky coast.

Surviving alone on wild shellfish and spring water, I was captured by a band of desert corsairs. Rather than weeping or surrendering to despair, I maintained my regal dignity, learned their language, and seized an opportunity to escape during a night thunderstorm.

Wandering into the mountains, I fell into the hands of the monstrous giant of the Black Castle, where I was imprisoned alongside forty-nine foreign princes, facing daily peril.

Yet my spirit remained unbroken; I encouraged the weeping prisoners with hope and faith until Prince Khudadad arrived like an angel of valor, slew the giant, and shattered our iron gates!

In Khudadad, I recognized not only an invincible warrior, but a soul of supreme mercy, chivalry, and forgiveness.'

The Princess of Daryabar ruled beside Khudadad, celebrated as a queen whose courage and resilience had matched the greatest heroes of the East.
moral: Courage, independence, and resilience sustain a noble soul through shipwreck and adversity.
